collisionPolicy: Only new source-timed poses inside the half-open 300 ms danger interval can hit. Danger steps, pose age and pose gaps must remain at most 150 ms through final outcome settlement. A clean dodge waits for the first post-danger source sample. Motion between observations is not inferred; sufficiently fast unsampled motion can be missed.
environment: Windows local verification used Node 24.16.0, pnpm 11.25.0 and the existing repository-local Python 3.12.14 environment. Repository pins remain Node 24.21.0 and Python 3.12.16; no global environment was changed. Browser: Microsoft Edge, local Vite server at 127.0.0.1:5182, English only.
corrections: Review and checks corrected source-time phase-boundary scoring, delayed final-danger reward settlement, strict sampling coverage through clearing, timed-endpoint source mapping, shared rehearsal clamp drift, keyboard focus, desktop stage width, 320 px scrollbar overflow and small-text contrast. The initial check failed on TypeScript narrowing; the next found an outdated touch-clamp expectation. The final complete software check passed.
